title: North Carolina Smart-City Systems Community Dataset
description: A sanitized, source-linked merge of two internship research tables. AI is represented as a reporting lens inside the broader smart-city systems model.

quality.verificationReminder: A visible source proves that evidence was found; it does not prove that a system is active, effective, endorsed, or current.

scopeNote: This is a researched sample, not a statewide census. Working source scope statements were inconsistent, and research depth varied by jurisdiction.
publicationNote: Personal contacts, raw notes with sensitive markers, internal or private links, and records without a safe public source are excluded.
